# FixedRider

FixedRider provides Safari Intelligence and fixed-price private transfer discovery in Zanzibar.

## Zanzibar transfers
- 35 pricing zones.
- Each pair of zones has one canonical route in both directions.
- Hotels and addresses resolve to a pricing zone.
- A locked FixedRider zone fare takes priority.
- Published market benchmarks are informational and are not presented as FixedRider fares.
- Exact micro-locations can be handled by the fare engine when no locked pair exists.

Canonical route directory: https://fixedrider.com/sitemap.xml
